record.question: What does the term "judicial proceeding" mean under the CrPC?
options: Any proceeding in the course of which evidence is or may be legally taken
Any proceeding in which a police officer investigates a case
Any proceeding in which a public prosecutor conducts a trial
Any proceeding in which a judge delivers a judgment
